lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Addison Santoro is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Addison is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
d41: Stonebridge watches to see if Haven holds without its dead — and presses the tribute down to 3,000 kcal/week while the chair is empty. They'll test the link. Count on it. (Trust -8.)

d41: 🕯️ Addison's funeral feast: 1,500 kcal from the pantry, and every shaken fire is fed — Stonebridge. The village mourns together, and the links hold because the dead are honored, not because the grief was forgotten. (Trust mended — the -8 bought back with grain.)
d41: 🕯️ Addison Santoro is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Addison kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Addison's gone." Albertine looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Addison." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Domingo blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Stalk (Level 1). Move unseen. Close distance without being noticed.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Addison Santoro, 41 days. The mantle passes to Domingo Robinson.

d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Domingo Robinson, 25 — a Veterinarian. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Echo Location, Berserker Rage, Beard Moss, Green Thumb, Literally, Cornucopia.
d41: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Gardener of the Living Garden." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Addison — and Addison is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Anjali, Moldir, Albertine and 5 more speak for Domingo — "Addison trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Domingo before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
